text:
sara: Customer acct acct-9876 reporting streaming tool-call args get cut mid-JSON and model returns invalid tool args. request_id=req_0a1b2c3d. cc @eng-runtime @eng-sre :eyes:

 tom: Can you paste the client request + observed SSE chunks?

 sara: Repro curl below, payload.json contains large "tool" args.

 ```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary @payload.json \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

 sara: payload.json (trimmed):

 ```
{
  "input": "generate",
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "place_order",
    "arguments": {
      "order_id": "ORD-443312",
      "items": [ ... large list ... ],
      "metadata": { "customer_note": "lots of text..." }
    }
  }
}
```

 sara: Observed SSE stream (server -> client) chunks, last good chunks then truncated:

 ```
event: message
data: {"delta": "...\n"

event: message
data: {"delta": "\"tool_call\": { \"name\": \"place_order\", \"arguments\": { \"order_id\": \"ORD-443312\", \"items\": [ {\"sku\": \"X1\", \"qty\": 2}, ... , {\"sku\": \"
```

 sara: The client sees the stream end with an open brace/unfinished array and then parses error: unexpected end of JSON.

 michael: We saw similar with HTTP/1.1 chunk boundaries cutting multibyte UTF-8 in half when proxies re-chunk. Do we have an LB in front? req_0a1b2c3d shows CloudFront + internal nginx.

 alex: Which model + runtime flags? Are you using streaming tool_call with chunked KV cache? Any quantization that causes different tokenization sizes? Also any instrumented middleware that modifies body? :thinking:

 sara: Model: redwood-api/gpt-infer-3b, streaming=true, no special quantization flags. There's an edge proxy (cdn.company.com) and an internal api-gateway (nginx) before the runtime.

 maria: Can we get haproxy/nginx logs for req_0a1b2c3d and tcpdump on the worker to see raw SSE bytes? If proxies re-chunk or restart connection we can see truncated last segment. Also check keepalive timeout: proxy reset at 2164322001 (conn closed after 120s).

 sara: I've attached minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-repro/ea1f2 (payload + curl). Quick mitigation suggested to customer: disable streaming (non-streaming tool_call) or send tool args as base64 in metadata to avoid newline boundaries.

 alex: Potential quick fix: runtime should emit final boundary marker after tool_call JSON (e.g., send a zero-length data event or explicit \"\uE000\" sentinel). Longer term: eng-runtime to verify SSE framing and ensure no mid-json truncation on worker flush.

 michael: ops: please check nginx config for "proxy_buffering" and "proxy_request_buffering" and increase chunk sizes or enable "chunked_transfer_encoding on". Also confirm we aren't dropping trailing CRLF.

 maria: I'll grab logs and tcpdump now and put results in INC-2210. tagging @eng-runtime.

 incident-bot: Created INC-2210: "streamed tool_call args truncated across proxy - req_0a1b2c3d"

 sara: Thanks all, customer accepted workaround to POST non-streaming until we patch. :thumbsup:
